objects.name: totals
variables: The object shows one row for each region, with a total.
It sums only the amount of the orders whose status is paid.
It reads the live feed `orders` and does not read a fixed copy.
It shows no error about a missing column.
The object `rows` shows fewer than 600 rows.
notes: Feed `orders` ends at 600 rows. When rows reaches 600, read object `totals` for the final total of each region. A column may get a new name; the runners of `totals` repair it.
